legal.responsibleUseNotice: Pakino is designed to remove watermarks from AI-generated content and assumes you own the content or have permission to modify it. This service is not for bypassing commercial or paid stock licensing.

items.a1: Watermarks from AI tools like Hailuo, Veo, Kling, Sora, Seedance, and Dola are supported.
items.q2: What happens to my files after processing?
items.a2: Input and output files are automatically deleted after 24 hours.
items.q3: Do I need to register to use it?
items.a3: Limited free processing is possible without registration, but you need to sign up for history and more credits.
items.a4: Yes, MP4, MOV, and WEBM videos are processed with audio preserved.
items.a5: Processing happens on our servers; the app does not process offline.
